controlLayout.overflow: A thumbnail with three visible actions keeps the first and a More disclosure. Original action buttons, state and names remain intact. Respect component-owned hidden actions; full views keep their direct controls.

controlNaming.description: Optional fixed toggle identity containing all visible caption aliases. Preserved in portable exports.

heroSize.description: Optional explicit dimensions or preset for the thumbnail hero; designSize remains the full composition.

rules: Declare designSize, stage, trigger, controls and a11y.
The shell owns the frame, dock and lifecycle.
Use one neutral ramp plus one accent; rendered text must be at least 11px.
Expose state changes through ctx.onAction or returned actions.
Do not start audio without a gesture or capture input outside the stage.
Use runtime-wrapped timers and return cleanup.
